cohort: The study included 146 Taiwanese mothers with inflammatory bowel disease and 1460 matched healthy pregnant women, who gave birth between 2004 and 2018.
finding: Pregnancy and perinatal outcomes were comparable in Taiwanese women with inflammatory bowel disease and matched healthy counterparts, though hypertensive disorders of pregnancy were less prevalent in the inflammatory bowel disease group.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed in cesarean deliveries between mothers with inflammatory bowel disease and the control group.
